## Home

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false

import sys, os
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio

pio.renderers.default = "notebook_connected"   # or whatever Quarto picks by default
pio.renderers[pio.renderers.default].config = {'displayModeBar': False}

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "..")))
from src.backend.backend_functions import *

initialize_data()
player_color_map, archetype_color_map, decktype_color_map = get_color_maps()

vintage_standings_df = get_vintage_standings()
archetype_game_winrate = get_data('archetype_game_winrate')
player_game_and_match_winrate = get_data('player_game_and_match_winrate')

archetype_game_winrate = archetype_game_winrate[archetype_game_winrate['season_id'] == 'Season-All']
player_game_and_match_winrate = player_game_and_match_winrate[player_game_and_match_winrate['season_id'] == 'Season-All']

total_drafts = vintage_standings_df['draft_id'].nunique()
total_players = vintage_standings_df['player'].nunique()
total_games = vintage_standings_df['games_played'].sum() if 'games_played' in vintage_standings_df else len(vintage_standings_df)


```

## Row {height=80%}

### Column {width=50%}

```{python}
#| title: "Drafts Attended"
summary_df_bar = (
    vintage_standings_df.groupby(['player'])
    .agg(Played_Games=('draft_id', 'count'))
    .reset_index()
    .sort_values('Played_Games', ascending=False)
    .head(15)
)

draftbar = px.bar(
    summary_df_bar, x='player', y='Played_Games', color='player',
    color_discrete_map=player_color_map, title=None,
    labels={'Played_Games': 'Count', 'player': ''},
)
draftbar.update_layout(plot_bgcolor='white', showlegend=False)

```

```{python}
#| title: "Drafts Won"
game_data_df_pie = vintage_standings_df[vintage_standings_df['standing'] == 1]
summary_df_pie = game_data_df_pie.groupby(['player']).agg(games_won=('draft_id', 'count')).reset_index()

piewon = px.pie(
    summary_df_pie, names='player', values='games_won', color='player',
    color_discrete_map=player_color_map, title=None,
)

piewon.update_layout(
    plot_bgcolor='white', paper_bgcolor='white',
    showlegend=False
)
```

### Column {width=50%}

```{python}
#| title: "Archetype Game Win Rate"
summary_df_bar = (
    archetype_game_winrate.groupby('archetype', as_index=False)
    .agg({'games_played': 'sum', 'games_won': 'sum'})
)
summary_df_bar['game_win_rate'] = summary_df_bar['games_won'] / summary_df_bar['games_played']
summary_df_bar = summary_df_bar.sort_values('game_win_rate', ascending=False)

archetype_fig = px.bar(
    summary_df_bar, x='archetype', y='game_win_rate', color='archetype',
    color_discrete_map=archetype_color_map, title=None,
    labels={'game_win_rate': 'Game Win Rate', 'archetype': ''},
)
archetype_fig = archetype_fig.update_layout(plot_bgcolor='white', showlegend=False)
archetype_fig = archetype_fig.update_xaxes(tickangle=0, ticktext=wrap_labels(summary_df_bar['archetype']), tickvals=summary_df_bar['archetype'])
archetype_fig = archetype_fig.update_yaxes(range=[0.3, summary_df_bar['game_win_rate'].max()], title='Game Win Rate')
archetype_fig
```

```{python}
#| title: "Game Win Rate by Player"
summary_df_avg_points = (
    player_game_and_match_winrate.groupby('player', as_index=False)
    .agg({'games_played': 'sum', 'games_won': 'sum'})
)
summary_df_avg_points['game_win_rate'] = summary_df_avg_points['games_won'] / summary_df_avg_points['games_played']
summary_df_avg_points = summary_df_avg_points.sort_values('game_win_rate', ascending=False).head(15)

avg_points_fig = px.bar(
    summary_df_avg_points, x='player', y='game_win_rate', color='player',
    color_discrete_map=player_color_map, title=None,
    labels={'game_win_rate': 'Game Win Rate', 'player': ''}
)
avg_points_fig = avg_points_fig.update_layout(plot_bgcolor='white', showlegend=False, yaxis=dict(title='Game Win Rate'))
avg_points_fig
```
